metadata.title: The dual Orlicz-Minkowski problem for capillary hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: We study curvature flows for the dual Orlicz--Minkowski problem for strictly convex capillary hypersurfaces in the Euclidean half-space. The prescribed function has the form $\phi(h)G(X)$, where $X=\nabla h+h\nu$ and $G$ may be nonradial and nonhomogeneous. For acute contact angles, the evenness assumption together with either of the two integral conditions yields a smooth weighted-volume-preserving flow for all $t>0$ and a smooth solution to the dual Orlicz--Minkowski equation. Without the evenness assumption, two strict spherical-cap barriers yield the same conclusions for an unnormalized flow, whose limiting hypersurfaces solve the dual Orlicz--Minkowski equation with $c=1$. A uniform strict monotonicity condition under rescaling ensures uniqueness for $c=1$ and convergence of the unnormalized flow in any $C^k$ norm at an exponential rate. The problem considered here includes the capillary $L_p$-Minkowski and $L_p$ dual Minkowski problems as special cases.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 欧氏半空间严格凸毛细超曲面，指定量为φ(h)G(X)，允许G非径向、非齐次。锐接触角下，偶性加两种积分条件之一给保加权体积流长时存在与光滑方程解；无偶性时改用两个严格球冠屏障及非归一化流得到c=1解。再加缩放下统一严格单调性，得c=1唯一性及任意C^k指数收敛。
analysis.breakthrough: 覆盖若干毛细Lp及dual Lp问题，并把非径向非齐次数据纳入框架。
analysis.limitations: 偶性方案、双屏障方案和指数收敛方案假设不同；不能把附加单调性下的唯一全流收敛归给所有数据。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
